backup_suffix.description: The suffix appended to the original file when saving a backup during -edit operations.

cpp_preprocessor.description: The path to the C preprocessor binary to use when processing resource files.

cpp_defines.description: List of C preprocessor macros to define. Each item should be a string like 'MY_VAR=1' or 'DEBUG'. Corresponds to -D/--define.

include_dirs.description: List of additional include directories for the C preprocessor. Corresponds to -I/--include.

disable_cpp.description: If true, disables the use of the C preprocessor for all trawldb operations involving resource files. Corresponds to --nocpp.
